card.name: Small words before an item in instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, with, and, of, an opening bracket) that come right before the name of a tool, substance or material in preparation or overdose-handling instructions, such as a spoon, emetics, soda lime or ipecac.

modes.description: 'with', 'of', 'and' or '(' just before a named agent such as emetics, ipecac, soda lime or DEHP.
